segments.name: Marine transportation
segments.description: Transports bulk liquid products such as petrochemicals, black oil, refined petroleum products and agricultural chemicals by tank barge for inland and coastal customers.
segments.evidence: The Company, through KMT, is a provider of marine transportation services, operating tank barges and towing vessels transporting bulk liquid products throughout the Mississippi River System, on the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway, and coastwise along all three United States coasts.
